title: Workspace Shell GitRunner Observability v1
goal: Widen Workspace Shell only enough to diagnose GitRunner/control-plane incidents without operator terminal relay: add exact read-only systemd inspection for selected Workspace CI controller/maintenance/v3 units and design a sanitized read-only maintenance-receipt interface, while preserving the existing ban on generic shell, generic systemctl, GitHub credentials, maintenance-socket mutation authority, sibling-project execution authority, and privileged helper widening.
acceptance_criteria: Workspace Shell can read systemd state for an exact allowlist of Workspace CI controller/maintenance/v3 units needed to diagnose GitRunner serviceability.
Unit inspection remains read-only fixed-property systemctl show; no restart/start/stop/enable verbs are introduced.
Workspace Shell receives no membership in workspace-ci-maintenance and no access to the maintenance mutation socket.
Maintenance receipt access, if implemented, exposes only sanitized structured receipt fields through a dedicated read-only path and never raw credentials/token files or arbitrary paths.
Queued GitHub Actions cancellation is not implemented by granting Workspace Shell generic GitHub/network credentials; cancellation remains a GitHub/control-plane concern.
Existing Workspace Shell unit allowlist, task binding, sandbox, receipt, and fail-closed behavior remain intact.
Exact-head hosted validation passes before any live install/update.
Any live update is separately bound to the exact validated head and preserves current accepted Workspace Shell services/transport/boot-disabled state.
constraints: Do not add arbitrary file reads.
Do not add workspace-ci-maintenance group membership to workspace-shell-mcp.
Do not expose /run/workspace-ci/maintenance/maintenance.sock to Workspace Shell.
Do not add GitHub tokens, runner tokens, SSH credentials, or general network egress to Workspace Shell.
Do not activate or migrate any GitRunner v3 class from this task.
Do not change Research GPU containment.
Do not reuse this observability task as authority for controller restart/canary/cutover.

inputs: operator explicit approval to widen Workspace Shell read/diagnostic authority to a bounded extent

evidence: Read-only unit allowlist expansion is limited to workspace-control legacy controller, maintenance controller/service, v3 provisioner/reconciler, and workspace-control v3 control-small controller.
No mutating systemctl operation, maintenance socket/group authority, credential access, sibling project unit, or GitHub network authority was added.

stages.resume_condition: Exact-head validation green and live-update procedure is bounded/reviewed.

remaining_work: Add regression tests proving authorized CI units are readable and unrelated units remain denied.
Design/implement sanitized maintenance-receipt read without maintenance socket/group authority.
Only after exact-head validation, prepare bounded live update that preserves accepted Workspace Shell transport and least privilege.
next_safe_action: Open a draft PR and run exact-head hosted validation. If green, design the sanitized maintenance-receipt read path as a separate read-only boundary; do not install live changes until the exact validated head is explicitly bound for Workspace Shell update.

evidence: PR #573 LIVE CHATGPT ACCEPTANCE COMPLETE records accepted Workspace Shell v1 runtime.
This observability branch is based directly on accepted head 44b4e4f2020450c81cec56e86b711cdee7e651d9.
Adds six exact read-only unit names; no mutation verbs.

Operator explicitly approved bounded Workspace Shell widening for queued-job cancellation and/or reading host maintenance receipts/controller unit state; this task implements only the read-only observability portion first.
No generic systemctl, maintenance socket access, group membership, credentials, sibling controller units, v3 activation, or GitHub cancellation authority added.
